sourceFile: 35. TIU C11-20 Report  find reason function high 2026.01.13_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable rows but the changed-factor and outcome grouping is too mixed for final evidence.
issues: One changed factor mixes many unrelated trials and sheets.
Baseline and changed conditions include lines, shifts, normals, and tests inconsistently.
Several comparisons appear to reuse controls from unrelated sections or dates.
Unknown and measurement outcomes are table/defect-column artifacts.
Not-judged candidate metrics remain in the evidence set.
requiredUserQuestions: Should each numbered test section be a separate changed-factor context?
correctionPlan: Split results by sheet section/table and preserve date, line, shift, and type keys.
Define one primary changed factor per corrected group from the section content.
Pair each test only with the matching normal/control row in the same context.
Recompute NG rate deltas and revise judgements per corrected pair.
Remove artifact measurement/unknown outcomes or reclassify as defect counts.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but they are insufficient until grouping and control pairing are corrected.
